title: Noise Field
description: An animated procedural noise generator — a source, not a filter. Choose fractal value noise (fBm), ridged, turbulence, plain value or white noise, scrolling through time so it churns, with a domain-warp control that folds it into organic marbling. Colour it mono (hue-tinted), RGB from three offset noises, or through warm, cool and spectral palettes. Scale, octaves, speed, warp, contrast and hue are live; the mic drives contrast.
